test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are colored Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Black, White. Select the color that will be on the face opposite to the one colored White.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41aad6b0f88fa83f1af60d150b2fa5e0240e501d563f54f09a061e88d534ddd6.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41aad6b0f88fa83f1af60d150b2fa5e0240e501d563f54f09a061e88d534ddd6.png] 

 

Red and yellow are common in both the dices.

Clearly, **Green will be on the face opposite to the White**.

Hence, **'Green'** is the correct answer.
